sections.text: You stand before the Ironvale Clocktower at midnight, hired to steal the Regent's Cog before dawn. The main door is guarded; a drainpipe offers another way up.

options.description: Bluff your way past the guard

sections.text: The pipe groans under your weight but holds. You reach a narrow window, unlatched.

consequence.text: The frame splinters, cutting your palm.

sections.text: You claim to be the Regent's clockwright. The guard studies you a moment too long.

consequence.text: The guard's baton catches your shoulder before you break free.

sections.text: Inside, the tower's gears fill the air with ticking. A maintenance ladder leads up toward the mechanism room.
You're through the door and into the tower proper, heart pounding. Stairs spiral upward into the dark.
The Regent's Cog sits exposed in the central mechanism, still turning. Removing it will stop the tower's clock entirely.

options.description: Look for a way to swap it without stopping the mechanism

sections.text: The clock shudders to a stop behind you as you flee into the night, cog in hand. Ironvale will wake to silence — and a very short list of suspects.
You find a brass replica in your pack, made just for this. The swap is seamless; the tower never misses a tick, and neither does your escape.
